title.rendered: Hindrances to Unanswered Prayers by Apostle Joshua Iyemifokhae

content.rendered: Hindrances to Unanswered Prayers by Apostle Joshua Iyemifokhae identifies the spiritual and practical barriers that prevent prayers from producing results. The message teaches believers to remove these hindrances through faith, obedience, righteousness, and alignment with God’s Word for an effective prayer life.
